operator-walkthrough.ref: What a customer and the crew see after this merges. On /tires, each of the three top-pick cards (Lowest price, Best value, Premium) gains a third control under Call about these tires: Text me this quote. Tapping it opens, in the card, a 48 px Mobile number field with a Send button and the line 'One text with this quote, nothing else. Reply STOP to opt out. We don't sell or rent contact info.' No dialog. A number that is not ten digits shows 'Enter a 10-digit mobile number.' in place. A good number sends and the card shows 'Sent. We will text you this quote in a minute.' If the shop's text could not go out (the number opted out, the lane paused, a gateway failure) the card says 'Saved. We could not text this number. Call (216) 862-0005 and we will go over it.' The customer's phone receives one text: shop name, qty x brand model (size), the vehicle when they searched by vehicle, the installed set total, a link back to /tires?size=<size> that reopens the same result, 'Payment Programs available', the shop phone, and the STOP footer sendSms adds. On the crew side, the quote is a tire_orders row named 'Quote by text' with the phone, tire, qty, price and vehicle, so it appears in Admin > Tire Orders > New Requests like a Request these order, with the customer note 'Quote by text from /tires (<pick> pick). Not an order yet: call to confirm fitment and book.' Staff also get a Telegram (receipt class) with the tire, total, vehicle, the phone's last four digits and whether the text went out. Nothing is invoiced, booked, or marked paid. The text rides ENABLE_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATIONS and the send_pause_customer_confirmations switch, as the five tire-order confirmations do. Tests: server/__tests__/tireQuote.test.ts (15), server/customer-message-templates.test.ts (+6), client/src/__tests__/tire-finder-v2.test.tsx (+6), plus the formLimiter and auth-tier registry entries; eleven mutation receipts recorded in the PR. Not device-tested: Nour's own tap on his phone after the deploy, and the first real text's arrival, are owed.
